title: Crowder Environments Control Interfacial Dynamics and Topological Stability in a Knotted Protein.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟研究拥挤剂PEG和葡聚糖对打结蛋白AOTCase界面动力学和拓扑稳定性的影响，核心对象为蛋白质结构，问题涉及构象动力学与稳定性，方法采用MD模拟，与课题高度相关。
abstract: Knotted proteins are unique biomolecules where backbone entanglement imposes intrinsic constraints on structure and dynamics. The interaction of such a topologically restrained protein with molecular crowders remains unexplored. Using molecular dynamics simulations, we investigate the effects of polyethylene glycol (PEG) and dextran on the structure, interactions, and topological dynamics of the trefoil-knotted enzyme AOTCase. Persistent, heterogeneous accumulation of dextran near the protein surface is observed, whereas PEG exhibits a transient interaction pattern. The distinct interfacial behaviors propagate into the protein's dynamical organization: dextran induces fragmentation of communication pathways, while PEG largely preserves network coherence. At elevated temperatures, dextran retards global denaturation compared to PEG or pure water, with the knotted core exhibiting reduced fluctuations. Our findings reveal that the effects of molecular crowding on knotted proteins arise from both excluded-volume effects and the chemical nature of crowder-protein interactions. This interplay can influence both local topological dynamics and global stability.
abstract_zh: 打结蛋白质是一类独特的生物分子，其骨架缠结对结构和动力学施加了内在约束。这种拓扑受限蛋白质与分子拥挤剂之间的相互作用尚未被探索。通过分子动力学模拟，我们研究了聚乙二醇（PEG）和葡聚糖对三叶结酶AOTCase的结构、相互作用和拓扑动力学的影响。观察到葡聚糖在蛋白质表面附近持续、异质的积累，而PEG则表现出瞬时的相互作用模式。不同的界面行为传播到蛋白质的动力学组织中：葡聚糖诱导通信通路碎片化，而PEG在很大程度上保持网络连贯性。在升高温度下，与PEG或纯水相比，葡聚糖延缓了全局变性，且打结核心表现出减少的波动。我们的发现揭示，分子拥挤对打结蛋白质的影响源于排除体积效应和拥挤剂-蛋白质相互作用的化学性质。这种相互作用可以影响局部拓扑动力学和全局稳定性。
